en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear. 'билно бие' is my reading ('the pulse beats'); 'би летнал' is a masculine conditional ('I would fly').

lines.en: All night I sit, all night I drink,
I pour wine, I hide tears,
I hide tears, I clench my heart,

lines.cyr: но од љубов не се бега.
lines.lat: no od ljubov ne se bega.
lines.en: but you cannot run from love.

lines.cyr: Да сум пиле, јас би летнал,
lines.lat: Da sum pile, jas bi letnal,
lines.en: If I were a bird, I would fly,

lines.cyr: да сум ветре, би те сретнал,
lines.lat: da sum vetre, bi te sretnal,
lines.en: if I were the wind, I would meet you,
but you are far away now,

lines.cyr: а од љубов не се бега.
lines.lat: a od ljubov ne se bega.
lines.en: and you cannot run from love.

lines.cyr: Јас сум човек, тешко ми е,
lines.lat: Jas sum čovek, teško mi e,
lines.en: I am a man, it is hard for me,
I seek a song, I seek a joke,

lines.cyr: но од љубов не се бега.
lines.lat: no od ljubov ne se bega.
lines.en: but you cannot run from love.
